title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-24
content:
Daily scratchpad - quick capture
Date: 2026-03-24
Owner: Jordan Lee

MORNING PLAN
- 9:00 sync with infra (capacity plan for GA) — confirm GPU quota + autoscale policy changes.
- 10:30 design review with UX on rollout messaging (short doc updates).
- 1:00 PM stakeholder demo prep (sales + CS) — need latest latency numbers + canary plan.
- Blocktime in afternoon to finish PRD edits and publish to Confluence.

PRD EDITS (hosting-rate-limits PRD) — quick checklist
- Summary: tighten wording around soft vs hard rate limits (intro, line 1). TODO: reword paragraph.
- Add SLA language: include 99.5% latency SLO for p95 (small note under Ops). TODO: confirm with SRE.
- Table: add expected throughput per SKU (dedicated vs hosted). Ethan to provide numbers by EOD.
- Rollout plan: clarify canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% and rollback criteria. Add metrics: error rate, latency, token cost delta.
- Security: reference KMS integration doc (link added). Verify wording with Security.

LAUNCH CHECKLIST (GA target: 2026-04-07)
- [ ] Finalize PRD (me) — target 2026-03-25 ✅ aim for morning
- [ ] Engineering sign-off on autoscale & fallback policies (Ethan) — blocked by infra quota
- [ ] SRE runbook draft (Marta) — first pass complete, needs playbook steps for region fallback
- [ ] Console UI copy + toggles for rate-limit override (Design) — UX review today
- [ ] Docs page publish + quickstart (Docs) — link for demo
- [ ] Sales enablement deck + FAQs (GTM) — draft due 2026-03-30
- [ ] Canary config in prod (infra) — create ticket, schedule run for 2026-03-31
- [ ] Final smoke tests & performance bench (bench team) — include 2M-token run

STAKEHOLDER FOLLOW-UPS (quick)
- Ping @Marta in #sre: ask for p95 baseline + current headroom (message sent, awaiting reply).
- DM @Ethan: need throughput numbers + ETA for autoscale change (requested last night).
- Send short note to legal about SLA wording — include risk/impact of noncompliance.

MEETING NOTES (9:00 infra sync)
- Quota: default hosted account GPU quota is fine but dedicated pools require reservation for GA.
- Infra: suggested fallback -> start routing to smaller model family if capacity low. Action: create playbook entry.
- Action items: infra to open quota request with cloud provider before 2026-03-29.

RISKS / BLOCKERS
- Quota approvals could slip -> postpone canary. Mitigation: prepare fallback to lower-capacity model (performance testing required).
- Docs readiness — Docs team bandwidth limited next week (GTM might delay).
- Security sign-off on KMS wording outstanding.

QUICK NOTES / IDEAS
- Consider a "burst credits" option for early customers to allow short-term overage. Quick pricing thought: $X per burst-minute.
- Add a small analytics event when fallback occurs (to surface to console and GTM).

ACTIONS (today)
- Publish PRD final draft in Confluence + tag eng/sre/design/legal — due EOD tomorrow.
- Add canary checklist to PRD (detailed metrics + rollback).
- Follow up with Ethan & Marta on throughput/quota (Slack + email).
- Prep 10-min demo for 1:00 PM stakeholder call (slides + console screenshots).

NOTES TO SELF
- Keep PRD language short, avoid implementation deep-dive — link to infra runbooks.
- Leave open questions section at bottom of PRD for reviewers.
- Save a copy of the demo deck as "hosted-api-ga-demo-v1.pptx" in shared_drives/product/hosted-api/launch.

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS
- Exact p95 latency SLO number to publish (tbd with SRE).
- Pricing for rate-limit override/burst credits (need finance input).

END OF DAY CHECK (to fill)
- PRD status: __
- Infra sign-off: __
- Docs published: __

-----
Small, messy — capture and iterate.
